thread:
sam: Heads-up: change window in 5m. Quick run through: canary plan, rollback gates, and pin lock. RN link: https://internal.releases/redwood/1.6.0

deploy-bot: Deploy queued by @sam. Start=2026-04-02T02:00:00Z. Plan: canary 4% x 7m -> 30% x 10m -> 100%. Pin bump v3.5.1 -> v3.6.0. Auto-fallback enabled for region failures.

priya: Staging smoke OK. embeddings p95=115ms, p99=195ms, errors=0.07%.

dan: Dashboards prepped. Alert thresholds: page @oncall-eu if 5xx >0.5% sustained 3m OR p99 +40% for 5m. I'll be on watch.

sam: Rollback triggers: 1) 5xx >0.6% sustained 3m, 2) p99 +45% for 5m, 3) critical client-facing errors. Rollback target = v3.5.1.

oncall-eu: I'll execute rollback runbook if needed. Owners: oncall-eu(rollback), priya(traces), dan(monitoring), release-manager(comms).

deploy-bot: Canary guard: pause and alert if canary error-rate >0.4% for 2 windows. No auto-rollback for canary-only noise.

priya: Note: kvcache warmup may show transient WARNs on reconnect. Expect a tail during initial prefixes.

sam: Locking pins now. @deploy-bot lock-pins
deploy-bot: Pins locked by @sam. Unpin needs release-manager + oncall-eu approval.

sam: Any objections?

priya: :thumbsup:
dan: ready
release-manager: ready to publish after success
oncall-eu: standing by

deploy-bot: Rollout started: canary 4% (7m). SLO guardrails active.

sam: Smoke items during canary: /health, sample convo, embedding-sanity queries (5).

priya: Canary minute 3: errors 0.06%, p99 190ms. Slight tail but within gates.

dan: Dashboards stable. Small latency tail on long sequences, no error clusters.

oncall-eu: Raising alert sensitivity for 20m window.

deploy-bot: Canary advanced to 30% at +7m automatically.

sam: Monitor redis connection counts and kvcache miss ratio. The refactor changes timeouts.

priya: Connection spike observed on start, normalized after warmup. No service errors.

release-manager: Drafted customer note; will publish after final confirmation.

sam: Preferred rollback command if needed:

/deploy rollback --to v3.5.1 --reason "canary threshold breach"

oncall-eu: If I initiate rollback, I'll post timestamps and not permit redeploy until retro.

deploy-bot: Rollout completed: status success. Regions green. Pins remain locked.

sam: Closing change window. Release-manager publish RN and customer comms. We'll run a short retro tomorrow for kvcache follow-ups.

release-manager: RN published. Post-deploy checklist done: image tagged, telemetry checkpoint, runbook updated.

priya: Follow-up: keep p99 watch for 24h for warm-start tails.

dan: I'll add a playbook note and extended dashboard retention.

sam: Thanks team, nice and quiet rollout. :rocket:
